The last Friday Evening Mass During the Month of November where we remember all our Loved ones who have died – Drumkilly Church at 8 pm Friday 27th November During this mass parishioners are invited to bring along their own candle which will be lit at the altar and placed on the cross at the sanctuary A Tree of Remembrance is in each church during November – place the name of your deceased loved one on the tree so that they will be prayed for and remembered during mass. Fr John Walsh (Limerick) will lead an evening of prayer for our faithful departed in St Brigid's Church, Killygarry on Thursday November 26th. Confessions from 6pm, Rosary 7pm & Holy Mass 7.30pm. Fr John will pray with everyone after mass and the evening will conclude with Benediction. Water, Salt and Oil will be blessed on the night. All welcome …………………………….
